sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.category 
FROM categories AS c 
INNER JOIN podcasts AS p ON c.podcast_id = p.podcast_id 
INNER JOIN reviews AS r ON p.podcast_id = r.podcast_id 
WHERE r.author_id = 'EFB34EAC8E9397C'
